description: Upload Clothing from public HTTP(S) image URLs. Queues a recoverable batch upload and returns an operation immediately; retry with the exact same arguments to read its state (a retry creates no second upload). Photos are stored as uploaded, without background removal; processing_mode is ignored. Prefer assets with {asset_kind: full|detail, asset_view: front|back|side, asset_url}; exactly one full front is required, every full view is unique, and detail views can repeat. No base64, chat file objects, or local paths.
